project.title: SMMS Search and Rescue Replacement Project

parentsummary.deliverables: Architected and delivered the AWS cloud replacement for the DND SARMASTER Search and Rescue management system, designing containerized ECS/Docker infrastructure with PostgreSQL, implementing ITSG-33 and DND-aligned security controls to achieve iATO, delivering IaC via CloudFormation Service Catalog products, and executing CI/CD pipeline integration with full GIS and live-data interface capability and 24/7 high-availability architecture.
parentsummary.outcomes: Modernized Canada's critical Search and Rescue operations management system with zero-downtime migration to AWS, achieving iATO status under stringent DND and TSB security requirements and delivering a containerized 24/7 available architecture supporting life-saving SAR operations across Canada.

challenge.summary: The technical challenge was to architect a containerized, cloud-native replacement for SARMASTER on AWS — capable of 24/7 high availability for life-safety SAR operations, real-time GIS and live-data interface integration, backup site capability, and full alignment to ITSG-33, DND, and TSB security standards sufficient to achieve iATO within a 22-month delivery timeline.

deliverables: Architectural design and PoC implementation with modernization of infrastructure
Security Coordination and architectural alignment to required Guidelines (ITSG-33, DND & TSB Cloud Compliance)
Implementation of IT Security to meet ITSG controls and achieve iATO
Engineered the access control posture for the SAR replacement platform
Facilitated requirements gathering with technical and systems team, business team and project management, external stakeholders, and security teams
Review and realign infrastructure as required from continuous development cycles
Staged implementation testing of services with inline remediation
Internal feedback to development and operations for change coordination
Integration to CI/CD pipeline, automation, and management systems
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deliverables in CloudFormation, deployed as Service Catalog Products
Pre-migratory testing and security reporting, and failure/high-availability testing
Documentation, knowledge transfer and cross-training with Operations staff, Development staff, and Management

outcomes: Successfully modernized critical Search and Rescue operations system with zero downtime migration to AWS cloud infrastructure
Delivered containerized architecture using Docker/ECS with PostgreSQL, ensuring 24/7 availability for life-saving SAR operations across Canada while meeting stringent DND security requirements
